checks.title: Calibration drift (action vs state on still frames)
checks.summary: 2 joint(s) miscalibrated; not compared: 9 different space, 16 no motion

findings.message: joint 7: still-frame offset -72.4% of range varies with position but not along a line (a step fits 0.7x as well) - backlash, load, contact or a joint limit rather than calibration
joint 8: still-frame offset -88.9% of range varies with position but not along a line (a step fits 1.0x as well) - backlash, load, contact or a joint limit rather than calibration
joint 10: commanded and measured position disagree by -96.8% of its range on still frames, the same across its range - leader/follower calibration drift; the policy learns a shifted target
joint 42: command and measurement drift apart across the range (-20.2% per full range, R^2 0.63) - a scale calibration error (gear ratio or units), not a fixed offset
